research_question: Can a compact typed MK_FUTURE map distinct reachable CNF proof states into exact future-equivalence classes and be updated from the prior interface plus a local authorized transition without reprocessing the full CNF state?

critical_distinction.MK_ID: Exact state identity for provenance/replay; equality should imply exact canonical state equality.
critical_distinction.MK_FUTURE: Correctness-relevant future interface; equality may intentionally merge distinct states iff all authorized future continuations are observationally equivalent.

future_equivalence.transition_domain: v in {1,2,3,4}; operations on absent variables are exact no-ops
future_equivalence.observation: SAT/UNSAT terminal verdict after any finite authorized continuation
future_equivalence.finite_oracle: Exact truth function over all 2^4 assignments. Equality of the frozen truth function is the evaluation oracle for future-equivalence in R0 only.
future_equivalence.distinguishing_continuation: For unequal truth functions, emit the lexicographically first complete ASSIGN continuation whose terminal verdicts differ.

reachable_universe.clause_pool: All non-tautological width-1 and width-2 clauses over variables 1..4.
reachable_universe.seed_family: All canonical CNFs containing one or two distinct clauses from the frozen pool.
reachable_universe.closure: BFS closure under every authorized ASSIGN and EXISTS transition, with exact CNF canonicalization, tautology removal, deduplication and subsumption.
reachable_universe.holdout_policy: R0 is a finite structural arena, not a generalization claim. No theorem promotion from bounded survival.

MK_STRUCT_V0.role: deliberately lossy structural candidate to test collision detection

MK_TRUTH_ORACLE.complexity_warning: Exponential in variable count; never a polynomial-interface claim.

MK_ROBDD_FIXED_ORDER.representation: Reduced ordered binary decision diagram with canonical hash-consed nodes and terminals 0/1.
update_algebra: BDD_EXISTS implemented as OR of false/true restrictions
MK_ROBDD_FIXED_ORDER.complexity_warning: R0 tests exact future semantics and local update congruence only. Universal polynomial ROBDD size/discovery is not assumed and remains OPEN/known-risk.

gates.G1_COLLISION_DETECTOR: Every equal-key pair that is not future-equivalent must yield and preserve an exact distinguishing continuation.
gates.G2_ROBDD_SOUND_MERGE: No pair with equal MK_ROBDD_FIXED_ORDER may have different exact future truth functions.
gates.G3_NONTRIVIAL_CERTIFIED_MERGE: At least one pair of distinct canonical CNF states must share the same exact future interface.
gates.G4_TRANSITION_CONGRUENCE: For every reachable state and every authorized transition a, ROBDD(T_a(S)) must equal U_a(ROBDD(S)).
gates.G5_DECISION_SUFFICIENCY: Terminal SAT/UNSAT observation must factor through MK_ROBDD_FIXED_ORDER.
gates.G6_REPLAY_LIFT: Every distinguishing collision receipt must include source states, key, continuation and replayed terminal verdicts.
gates.G7_COST_ACCOUNTING: Record state bytes, key bytes/nodes, discovery work, update work, comparison count and closure transition count; no pointer/hash is free.
gates.G8_NO_THEOREM_PROMOTION: Finite survival must never be reported as P=NP, universal polynomiality, or arbitrary-CNF sufficiency.
